datasets.name: ds_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS flows,
  SUM(pred_is_attack) AS alerts,
  ROUND(100 * AVG(pred_is_attack), 2) AS alert_rate_pct
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.predictions

datasets.name: ds_alert_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.dstip) AS targeted_hosts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.srcip) AS attacking_sources
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.predictions p
JOIN cyber_lakehouse.silver.traffic_clean s USING (flow_hash)
WHERE p.pred_is_attack = 1

datasets.name: ds_alerts_session1
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(s.stime)) AS hour,
  p.pred_attack_cat AS family,
  COUNT(*) AS alerts
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.predictions p
JOIN cyber_lakehouse.silver.traffic_clean s USING (flow_hash)
WHERE p.pred_is_attack = 1 AND TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(s.stime) < TIMESTAMP'2015-02-01'
GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_alerts_session2
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(s.stime)) AS hour,
  p.pred_attack_cat AS family,
  COUNT(*) AS alerts
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.predictions p
JOIN cyber_lakehouse.silver.traffic_clean s USING (flow_hash)
WHERE p.pred_is_attack = 1 AND TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(s.stime) >= TIMESTAMP'2015-02-01'
GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_alerts_by_family
queryLines:
SELECT pred_attack_cat AS family, COUNT(*) AS alerts
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.predictions
WHERE pred_is_attack = 1
GROUP BY 1

datasets.name: ds_top_targets
queryLines:
SELECT
  s.dstip AS host,
  COUNT(*) AS alerts,
  CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(p.pred_attack_cat))) AS families
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.predictions p
JOIN cyber_lakehouse.silver.traffic_clean s USING (flow_hash)
WHERE p.pred_is_attack = 1
GROUP BY s.dstip
ORDER BY alerts DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_top_alerts
queryLines:
SELECT
  TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(s.stime) AS flow_start,
  s.srcip, s.sport, s.dstip, s.dsport, s.proto, s.service,
  p.pred_attack_cat AS family,
  ROUND(p.pred_proba, 4) AS attack_probability
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.predictions p
JOIN cyber_lakehouse.silver.traffic_clean s USING (flow_hash)
WHERE p.pred_is_attack = 1
ORDER BY p.pred_proba DESC, s.stime
LIMIT 100

datasets.name: ds_selected_model
queryLines:
SELECT
  model,
  threshold,
  ROUND(100 * test_precision, 1) AS precision_pct,
  ROUND(100 * test_recall, 1) AS recall_pct,
  ROUND(test_f1, 3) AS f1
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.model_metrics
WHERE selected

datasets.name: ds_model_metrics
queryLines:
SELECT
  model,
  selected,
  ROUND(threshold, 3) AS threshold,
  ROUND(val_precision, 4) AS val_precision,
  ROUND(test_precision, 4) AS test_precision,
  ROUND(test_recall, 4) AS test_recall,
  ROUND(test_f1, 4) AS test_f1,
  ROUND(test_roc_auc, 4) AS test_roc_auc,
  ROUND(test_f1_at_0_5, 4) AS test_f1_at_0_5
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.model_metrics
ORDER BY val_precision DESC

datasets.name: ds_family_metrics
queryLines:
SELECT
  model,
  selected,
  ROUND(val_macro_f1, 4) AS val_macro_f1,
  ROUND(test_macro_f1, 4) AS test_macro_f1,
  ROUND(test_accuracy, 4) AS test_accuracy
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.family_model_metrics
ORDER BY val_macro_f1 DESC

datasets.name: ds_quality_latest
queryLines:
SELECT check_name, layer, status, violations, description, run_ts
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.quality_results
WHERE run_ts = (SELECT MAX(run_ts) FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.quality_results)
ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'fail' THEN 0 WHEN 'missing' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, layer, check_name

datasets.name: ds_quality_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checks_passing,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checks_failing,
  MAX(run_ts) AS last_run
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.quality_results
WHERE run_ts = (SELECT MAX(run_ts) FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.quality_results)

datasets.name: ds_quality_history
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_ts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'missing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing
FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.quality_results
GROUP BY run_ts
ORDER BY run_ts DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_ingestion
queryLines:
SELECT
  b.ingest_ts AS batch,
  b.raw_rows,
  COALESCE(s.new_flows, 0) AS new_unique_flows,
  b.raw_rows - COALESCE(s.new_flows, 0) AS duplicates_or_rejected
FROM (SELECT ingest_ts, COUNT(*) AS raw_rows FROM cyber_lakehouse.bronze.traffic GROUP BY ingest_ts) b
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ingest_ts, COUNT(*) AS new_flows FROM cyber_lakehouse.silver.traffic_clean GROUP BY ingest_ts) s
  USING (ingest_ts)
ORDER BY batch

datasets.name: ds_ingestion_totals
queryLines:
SELECT
  b.raw_rows,
  s.unique_flows,
  ROUND(100 * (b.raw_rows - s.unique_flows) / b.raw_rows, 1) AS removed_pct
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS raw_rows FROM cyber_lakehouse.bronze.traffic) b
CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS unique_flows FROM cyber_lakehouse.silver.traffic_clean) s

datasets.name: ds_layer_counts
queryLines:
SELECT '1 bronze' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM cyber_lakehouse.bronze.traffic
UNION ALL SELECT '2 silver', COUNT(*) FROM cyber_lakehouse.silver.traffic_clean
UNION ALL SELECT '3 gold', COUNT(*) FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.features
UNION ALL SELECT '4 predictions', COUNT(*) FROM cyber_lakehouse.gold.predictions

Every UNSW-NB15 flow is scored by the alert model at its validation-tuned threshold (≥95% recall) and labeled with an attack family. Counts cover the whole dataset; model quality is on the **Model quality** page.

All numbers below are on the held-out **test split** (20% of a stratified sample), which was never used to choose a threshold or a model. The alert threshold is the highest-precision one that still catches ≥95% of attacks on the validation split.

# Pipeline health

Data-quality checks run at the end of every pipeline run and are appended to `gold.quality_results`; a failing check fails the Workflow. Ingestion is incremental: each micro-batch adds raw rows to bronze, and only flows not seen before become new rows in silver.

frame.title: Rows per micro-batch
frame.description: Raw rows land in bronze; only flows not seen before become new silver rows.
